statements:
CREATE TABLE application_settings (
      setting_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      setting_value TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE assessment_template_drafts (
      draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      answers_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

      FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
        REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE cabinet_practices (
    cabinet_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE care_episode_assessment_notes (
        assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        note_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        PRIMARY KEY(assessment_id, note_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id)
          REFERENCES care_episode_assessments(assessment_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(note_id)
          REFERENCES care_episode_notes(note_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_assessment_tests (
        assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        exo_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        PRIMARY KEY(assessment_id, exo_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(assessment_id)
          REFERENCES care_episode_assessments(assessment_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_assessments (
        assessment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        content_json TEXT NOT NULL,

        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
        
        author_practitioner_id TEXT NULL,
        recipient_text TEXT NULL,
        docx_file_name TEXT NULL,

        assessment_date INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NULL,
        archived_at INTEGER NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
          REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_bodymaps (
        care_episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (care_episode_id) REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
          ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_document_edit_drafts (
      document_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

      PRIMARY KEY(document_type, document_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_notes (
  note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  note_date INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NULL,
  archived_at INTEGER NULL,

  FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
    REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
)

CREATE TABLE care_episode_referring_practitioners (
      assignment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

      care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      practitioner_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      ended_at INTEGER NULL,

      FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
        REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id),

      FOREIGN KEY(practitioner_id)
        REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_report_notes (
      report_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      note_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      PRIMARY KEY(report_id, note_id),

      FOREIGN KEY(report_id)
        REFERENCES care_episode_reports(report_id),

      FOREIGN KEY(note_id)
        REFERENCES care_episode_notes(note_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_report_tests (
      report_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      exo_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      PRIMARY KEY(report_id, exo_id),

      FOREIGN KEY(report_id)
        REFERENCES care_episode_reports(report_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE care_episode_reports (
    report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_assessment_id TEXT NULL,
    author_practitioner_id TEXT NULL,
    recipient_text TEXT NULL,
    docx_file_name TEXT NULL,

    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    report_date INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NULL,
    archived_at INTEGER NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
      REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id),

    FOREIGN KEY(source_assessment_id)
      REFERENCES care_episode_assessments(assessment_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE care_episodes (
    care_episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    pathology_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    initial_report TEXT NULL,
    initial_report_docx_path TEXT NULL,
    objective_data TEXT NULL,
    assessment_data TEXT NULL,
    treatment_plan TEXT NULL,
    final_conclusion TEXT NULL,
    opened_at INTEGER NULL,
    prescribing_correspondent_id TEXT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NULL,
    archived_at INTEGER NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY(patient_id)
      REFERENCES patients(patient_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE desktop_backups (
        backup_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
        notes TEXT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_import_session_files (
        session_file_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

        import_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        file_path TEXT NULL,
        file_size INTEGER NULL,

        processed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

        imported_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        skipped_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        duplicate_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        conflict_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        imported_metrics_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        error_message TEXT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(import_session_id)
          REFERENCES desktop_import_sessions(import_session_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_import_sessions (
        import_session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

        started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        completed_at INTEGER NULL,

        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',

        selected_patient_id TEXT NULL,
        selected_care_episode_id TEXT NULL,

        processed_files_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        failed_files_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

        imported_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        skipped_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        duplicate_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        conflict_results_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        imported_metrics_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

        source_label TEXT NULL,
        notes TEXT NULL,
        
        summary_patient_label TEXT NULL,
        summary_episode_label TEXT NULL,
        summary_exercises_label TEXT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(selected_patient_id)
          REFERENCES patients(patient_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(selected_care_episode_id)
          REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_restore_history (
        restore_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        restored_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        source_backup_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        safety_backup_path TEXT NULL,
        success INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        message TEXT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_result_conflicts (
        conflict_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

        result_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        existing_hash TEXT NULL,
        incoming_hash TEXT NOT NULL,

        existing_json TEXT NULL,
        incoming_json TEXT NOT NULL,

        detected_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

        resolution_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        resolved_at INTEGER NULL,
        resolution_note TEXT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(result_id)
          REFERENCES desktop_results(result_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_result_metrics (
        metric_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        result_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        metric_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        value REAL NOT NULL,
        unit TEXT NULL,
        label TEXT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(result_id)
          REFERENCES desktop_results(result_id),

        UNIQUE(result_id, metric_key)
      )

CREATE TABLE desktop_results (
        result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

        care_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        patient_id TEXT NULL,
        practitioner_id TEXT NULL,
        source_device_id TEXT NULL,

        practitioner_label_snapshot TEXT NULL,
        practitioner_verification_status TEXT NULL,

        mobile_episode_id TEXT NULL,
        mobile_pathology_code TEXT NULL,
        mobile_pathology_label TEXT NULL,
        mobile_patient_ref TEXT NULL,
        mobile_patient_label TEXT NULL,

        createdAt INTEGER NOT NULL,
        imported_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

        exoId TEXT NOT NULL,

        scoreTotal REAL NULL,
        comment TEXT NULL,

        exportSimpleText TEXT NOT NULL,
        simpleExportSnapshotJson TEXT NULL,

        structuredJson TEXT NULL,

        ageYears INTEGER NULL,
        sexCode TEXT NULL,
        testedSideCode TEXT NULL,
        measureUnit TEXT NULL,

        heightCm INTEGER NULL,
        weightKg REAL NULL,
        bmi REAL NULL,

        sportLevelCode TEXT NULL,
        contextCode TEXT NULL,

        testCode TEXT NULL,
        testVersion INTEGER NULL,
        testFamily TEXT NULL,

        localSchemaVersion INTEGER NULL,

        archived_at INTEGER NULL,

        sync_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'imported',
        last_modified_at INTEGER NULL,
        content_hash TEXT NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(care_episode_id)
          REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(patient_id)
          REFERENCES patients(patient_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(practitioner_id)
          REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id),

        FOREIGN KEY(source_device_id)
          REFERENCES paired_devices(device_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE document_approval_invalidations (
    approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL, invalidated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_attempt_results (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES document_attempts(attempt_id),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','indeterminate')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_attempts (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    version_id TEXT NOT NULL, patient_id TEXT NOT NULL, pdf_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, control_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode='simulation'), started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(patient_id,pdf_hash))

CREATE TABLE document_chain_steps (
    step_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, chain_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version_id TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('passed','blocked','reserved','result')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, data_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_control_config (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_control_invalidations (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL, invalidated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_control_results (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_control_runs (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version_id TEXT NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL, configuration_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    configuration_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, directory TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_dv1_configurations (
    revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, data_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, document_id TEXT,
    version_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, reference_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(kind,reference_id))

CREATE TABLE document_holds (
    version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, held INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(held IN (0,1)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL, changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_medical_approvals (
    approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_id TEXT NOT NULL, patient_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    author_id TEXT NOT NULL, validator_id TEXT NOT NULL, context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT,
    snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    attestations_json TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_medical_changes (
    change_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, source_table TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_practice_contexts (
    context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, practitioner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_preparations (
    version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE document_reconciliations (
    review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id TEXT, previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, restore_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','indeterminate')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL, reviewed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(target_key,source_hash,restore_hash),
    FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES episode_document_versions(version_id),
    FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES document_attempts(attempt_id))

CREATE TABLE document_restore_barriers (
    barrier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE episode_document_versions (
    version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_number > 0),
    previous_version_id TEXT NULL,
    relative_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64),
    byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_size > 0),
    mime_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mime_type = 'application/pdf'),
    page_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page_count > 0),
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('external','report','assessment','legacy_piece')),
    source_id TEXT NULL,
    source_revision TEXT NULL,
    captured_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(document_id, sequence_number),
    FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES episode_documents(document_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    FOREIGN KEY(previous_version_id) REFERENCES episode_document_versions(version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  )

CREATE TABLE episode_documents (
      document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      case_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
      mime_type TEXT NULL,
      source TEXT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NULL,
      archived_at INTEGER NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(case_id)
        REFERENCES care_episodes(care_episode_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE external_correspondents (
      correspondent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      first_name TEXT NULL,
      profession TEXT NULL,
      specialty TEXT NULL,
      address_line1 TEXT NULL,
      address_line2 TEXT NULL,
      postal_code TEXT NULL,
      city TEXT NULL,
      email TEXT NULL,
      phone TEXT NULL,
      archived_at INTEGER NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE kobus_archives (
    archive_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_path TEXT NOT NULL, shared INTEGER NOT NULL, practitioner TEXT,
    storage_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE kobus_items (
    item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    shared INTEGER NOT NULL, practitioner TEXT, identity_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, warnings TEXT NOT NULL,
    patient_id TEXT, created_patient INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    storage_path TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES kobus_runs(run_id))

CREATE TABLE kobus_runs (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, zip_name TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    finished_at INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL, temporary_path TEXT)

CREATE TABLE paired_devices (
        device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        practitioner_id TEXT NULL,
        device_label TEXT NOT NULL,
        platform TEXT NULL,
        public_key TEXT NULL,
        paired_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        last_seen_at INTEGER NULL,
        archived_at INTEGER NULL,

        FOREIGN KEY(practitioner_id)
          REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE patient_attributes (
      attribute_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

      patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      attribute_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      attribute_value TEXT NULL,

      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

      FOREIGN KEY(patient_id)
        REFERENCES patients(patient_id),

      UNIQUE(patient_id, attribute_key)
    )

CREATE TABLE patient_document_folders (
        patient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        root_path TEXT NOT NULL,
        folder_name TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
        PRIMARY KEY (patient_id, root_path),
        UNIQUE (root_path, folder_name)
      )

CREATE TABLE patient_fr_health_identity (
      patient_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

      ins_number TEXT NULL,
      ins_key TEXT NULL,
      ins_oid TEXT NULL,

      birth_last_name TEXT NULL,
      birth_first_names TEXT NULL,
      birth_date TEXT NULL,
      sex_code TEXT NULL,
      birth_place_code TEXT NULL,

      identity_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'provisional',
      identity_doubtful INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

      identity_validation_method TEXT NULL,
      identity_validated_at INTEGER NULL,
      identity_validated_by TEXT NULL,

      ins_retrieved_at INTEGER NULL,
      ins_last_checked_at INTEGER NULL,

      updated_at INTEGER NULL, cnda_recipe_json TEXT NULL, used_last_name TEXT NULL, used_first_name TEXT NULL, first_birth_name TEXT NULL, birth_place_label TEXT NULL, beneficiary_number TEXT NULL, beneficiary_relationship TEXT NULL, beneficiary_quality_code TEXT NULL, identity_homonym INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, identity_fictitious INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ins_traits_current INTEGER NULL,

      FOREIGN KEY(patient_id)
        REFERENCES patients(patient_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

CREATE TABLE patient_identity (
      patient_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

      national_health_id TEXT NULL,
      health_system_country TEXT NULL,
      identity_source TEXT NULL,

      phone TEXT NULL,
      email TEXT NULL,
      address TEXT NULL,

      last_verified_at INTEGER NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

      FOREIGN KEY(patient_id)
        REFERENCES patients(patient_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE patient_identity_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(patient_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      event_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      actor_id TEXT NULL,
      actor_name TEXT NULL,
      before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      after_json TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE patient_vitale_readings (
      reading_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(patient_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      read_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source = 'carte_vitale'),
      identity_json TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE patients (
        patient_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        birth_date TEXT NULL,
        sex_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'U',
        nir TEXT NULL,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NULL,
        archived_at INTEGER NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE planning_appointments (
      appointment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(appointment_id)) > 0),
      practitioner_id TEXT,
      patient_id TEXT REFERENCES patients(patient_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      event_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'appointment' CHECK(event_kind IN ('appointment', 'unavailable')),
      title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) > 0),
      appointment_date TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK(appointment_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
      start_minute INTEGER,
      end_minute INTEGER,
      notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      color_argb INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(color_argb BETWEEN 0 AND 4294967295),
      CHECK (
        (start_minute IS NULL AND end_minute IS NULL) OR
        (start_minute IS NOT NULL AND end_minute IS NOT NULL AND
         start_minute >= 0 AND end_minute <= 1440 AND end_minute > start_minute)
      )
    )

CREATE TABLE practitioner_cabinet_memberships (
    membership_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    cabinet_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cabinet_practices(cabinet_id),
    practitioner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id),
    role TEXT NOT NULL, start_date TEXT, end_date TEXT,
    cps_situation_number INTEGER, active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(cabinet_id, practitioner_id))

CREATE TABLE practitioner_cps_dates (
    practitioner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES practitioner_cps_profiles(practitioner_id),
    profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL, read_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    issue_date TEXT, exercise_starts_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    provenance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provenance = 'user_declared'))

CREATE TABLE practitioner_cps_profiles (
    practitioner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id),
    national_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    profile_json TEXT NOT NULL, profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    read_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
    provenance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provenance = 'cps_local_read'))

CREATE TABLE practitioners (
        practitioner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        working_hours_json TEXT NULL,
        appointment_step_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15 CHECK(appointment_step_minutes IN (15, 20, 30)),
        appointment_duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 45 CHECK(appointment_duration_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 840),
        first_name TEXT NULL,
        last_name TEXT NULL,
        professional_id TEXT NULL,
        email TEXT NULL,
        phone TEXT NULL,
        is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at INTEGER NULL,
        archived_at INTEGER NULL
      )
CREATE INDEX document_controls_version ON document_control_runs(version_id,started_at)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dv1_chain_phase
    ON document_chain_steps(chain_id,phase) WHERE phase LIKE 'dv1_%'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_assessment_template_drafts_episode_template
    ON assessment_template_drafts(
      care_episode_id,
      template_id
    )

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_assessments_episode_id
      ON care_episode_assessments(care_episode_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_assessments_status
      ON care_episode_assessments(care_episode_id, status)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_notes_episode_id
      ON care_episode_notes(care_episode_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_referring_practitioners_episode_id
    ON care_episode_referring_practitioners(care_episode_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_referring_practitioners_practitioner_id
    ON care_episode_referring_practitioners(practitioner_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episode_reports_episode_id
      ON care_episode_reports(care_episode_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_care_episodes_patient_id
      ON care_episodes(patient_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_import_session_files_session_id
      ON desktop_import_session_files(import_session_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_result_conflicts_result_id
      ON desktop_result_conflicts(result_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_result_metrics_result_id
      ON desktop_result_metrics(result_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_results_care_episode_id
      ON desktop_results(care_episode_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_results_exo_id
      ON desktop_results(exoId)

CREATE INDEX idx_desktop_results_patient_id
      ON desktop_results(patient_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_episode_documents_case_id
    ON episode_documents(case_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_medical_approval_version
    ON document_medical_approvals(version_id, approved_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_medical_changes_source ON document_medical_changes(source_table, source_id, change_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_planning_appointments_date
    ON planning_appointments(appointment_date, start_minute)
CREATE INDEX idx_planning_patient ON planning_appointments(patient_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_planning_practitioner ON planning_appointments(practitioner_id, appointment_date)
CREATE INDEX kobus_patient ON kobus_archives(patient_id)
CREATE INDEX kobus_run_items ON kobus_items(run_id)
CREATE INDEX patient_identity_events_patient ON patient_identity_events(patient_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX patient_vitale_readings_patient ON patient_vitale_readings(patient_id, read_at)

CREATE TRIGGER care_episodes_keep_pdf_versions
      BEFORE DELETE ON care_episodes
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM episode_document_versions WHERE episode_id = OLD.care_episode_id)
      BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Des versions PDF sont conservees : archiver plutot que supprimer'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chain_delete
      BEFORE DELETE ON document_chain_steps BEGIN
      SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Preuve de chaîne DMP immuable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chain_journal
    AFTER INSERT ON document_chain_steps BEGIN INSERT INTO document_events
    (document_id,version_id,kind,reference_id,detail,created_at)
    VALUES(NEW.document_id,NEW.version_id,'chain_' || NEW.state,NEW.step_id,

CREATE TRIGGER dv1_reservation_guard
    BEFORE INSERT ON document_chain_steps WHEN NEW.phase='dv1_reservation' AND (
      NEW.state!='reserved' OR
      NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM episode_document_versions WHERE version_id=NEW.version_id AND document_id=NEW.document_id) OR
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_restore_barriers) OR
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_attempts a JOIN episode_document_versions v ON v.version_id=NEW.version_id
        WHERE a.document_id=NEW.document_id OR (a.patient_id=v.patient_id AND a.pdf_hash=v.sha256)) OR
      (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps s
        JOIN episode_document_versions old ON old.version_id=s.version_id
        JOIN episode_document_versions v ON v.version_id=NEW.version_id
        WHERE s.phase='dv1_reservation' AND
          (s.document_id=NEW.document_id OR (old.patient_id=v.patient_id AND old.sha256=v.sha256)))
      AND NOT (
        CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.data_json) THEN
          json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.replacement.schema')=1 AND
          NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps z
            JOIN episode_document_versions ov ON ov.version_id=z.version_id
            JOIN episode_document_versions nv ON nv.version_id=NEW.version_id
            WHERE z.phase='dv1_reservation' AND (z.version_id=NEW.version_id OR
              (ov.patient_id=nv.patient_id AND ov.sha256=nv.sha256))) AND
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps src
            JOIN episode_document_versions ov ON ov.version_id=src.version_id
            JOIN episode_document_versions nv ON nv.version_id=NEW.version_id
            JOIN document_chain_steps result ON result.chain_id=src.chain_id AND result.phase='dv1_response'
            WHERE src.phase='dv1_reservation' AND src.document_id=NEW.document_id AND
              src.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.replacement.attemptId') AND
              src.version_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.replacement.versionId') AND
              src.data_hash=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.replacement.reservationHash') AND
              ov.patient_id=nv.patient_id AND ov.sequence_number<nv.sequence_number AND ov.sha256!=nv.sha256 AND
              json_extract(result.data_json,'$.outcome')='accepted' AND
              NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps later WHERE later.phase='dv1_reservation'
                AND later.document_id=NEW.document_id AND later.rowid>src.rowid))
        ELSE 0 END IS 1 OR (
        CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.data_json) THEN
          ((json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-typeCode-11490-label' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedTypeLabelProfile')='dv1-11490-type-label-1') OR
           json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' OR
           (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-patientId-missing-NH' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedPatientIdProfile')='ins-nh-1') OR
           (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-labels-signature' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedPatientIdProfile')='ins-nh-1' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedMetadataProfile')='dv1-labels-signature-1') OR
           (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-signature-title' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedPatientIdProfile')='ins-nh-1' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedMetadataProfile')='dv1-labels-signature-1' AND
            json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedSignatureTitleProfile')='event-source-1')) AND
          json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.correctedProfile')='dv1-20261028' AND
          json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.preparationPolicy')='identical-content-preserve-invalidation' AND
          length(json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.evidenceHash'))=64 AND
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_chain_steps s
            JOIN episode_document_versions old ON old.version_id=s.version_id
            JOIN episode_document_versions v ON v.version_id=NEW.version_id
            WHERE s.phase='dv1_reservation' AND
              (s.document_id=NEW.document_id OR (old.patient_id=v.patient_id AND old.sha256=v.sha256)))=
            CASE json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason') WHEN 'XDS-typeCode-11490-label' THEN 1 WHEN 'SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' THEN 1 WHEN 'XDS-patientId-missing-NH' THEN 2 WHEN 'XDS-labels-signature' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AND
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps original
            WHERE original.phase='dv1_reservation' AND original.state='reserved' AND
              original.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId') AND
              original.chain_id!=NEW.chain_id AND original.version_id=NEW.version_id AND
              original.document_id=NEW.document_id AND
              json_extract(original.data_json,'$.approvalId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.approvalId') AND
              json_extract(original.data_json,'$.snapshotHash')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.snapshotHash') AND
              json_extract(original.data_json,'$.controlRunId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.controlRunId') AND
              json_extract(original.data_json,'$.cdaHash')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.cdaHash') AND
              ((json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-typeCode-11490-label' AND
                 json_type(original.data_json,'$.retry') IS NULL AND
                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps response
                   WHERE response.phase='dv1_response' AND response.state='result' AND
                     response.chain_id=original.chain_id AND response.version_id=original.version_id AND
                     json_extract(response.data_json,'$.outcome')='rejected' AND
                     json_extract(response.data_json,'$.scope')='dv1' AND
                     json_extract(response.data_json,'$.packageHash')=json_extract(original.data_json,'$.packageHash'))) OR
               json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' OR
                (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-patientId-missing-NH' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND
                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps first
                   WHERE first.phase='dv1_reservation' AND first.version_id=NEW.version_id AND first.document_id=NEW.document_id AND
                   first.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND first.chain_id!=original.chain_id)) OR
                (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-labels-signature' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-patientId-missing-NH' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.secondAttemptId') AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND
                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps second JOIN document_chain_steps first
                   ON first.chain_id=json_extract(second.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')
                   WHERE second.phase='dv1_reservation' AND first.phase='dv1_reservation' AND
                     second.version_id=NEW.version_id AND first.version_id=NEW.version_id AND
                     second.document_id=NEW.document_id AND first.document_id=NEW.document_id AND
                     second.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.secondAttemptId') AND
                     first.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND
                     json_extract(second.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' AND
                     first.chain_id!=second.chain_id AND second.chain_id!=original.chain_id AND first.chain_id!=original.chain_id)) OR
                (json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-signature-title' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-labels-signature' AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.thirdAttemptId') AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND
                 json_extract(original.data_json,'$.retry.secondAttemptId')=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.secondAttemptId') AND
                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_chain_steps third
                   JOIN document_chain_steps second ON second.chain_id=json_extract(third.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')
                   JOIN document_chain_steps first ON first.chain_id=json_extract(second.data_json,'$.retry.previousAttemptId')
                   WHERE third.phase='dv1_reservation' AND second.phase='dv1_reservation' AND first.phase='dv1_reservation' AND
                     third.version_id=NEW.version_id AND second.version_id=NEW.version_id AND first.version_id=NEW.version_id AND
                     third.document_id=NEW.document_id AND second.document_id=NEW.document_id AND first.document_id=NEW.document_id AND
                     third.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.thirdAttemptId') AND
                     second.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.secondAttemptId') AND
                     first.chain_id=json_extract(NEW.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId') AND
                     json_extract(third.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='XDS-patientId-missing-NH' AND
                     json_extract(third.data_json,'$.retry.firstAttemptId')=first.chain_id AND
                     json_extract(second.data_json,'$.retry.reason')='SOAP-MustUnderstand-Security' AND
                     third.chain_id!=original.chain_id AND third.chain_id!=second.chain_id AND third.chain_id!=first.chain_id AND
                     first.chain_id!=second.chain_id AND second.chain_id!=original.chain_id AND first.chain_id!=original.chain_id))))
        ELSE 0 END IS 1))))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Renvoi DV1 bloqué : tentative ou restauration'); END

CREATE TRIGGER reconciliation_delete
      BEFORE DELETE ON document_reconciliations BEGIN
      SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Examen de réconciliation immuable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER reconciliation_insert
    BEFORE INSERT ON document_reconciliations WHEN
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_reconciliations WHERE review_id=NEW.review_id
        OR (target_key=NEW.target_key AND source_hash=NEW.source_hash AND restore_hash=NEW.restore_hash))
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM episode_document_versions
        WHERE version_id=NEW.version_id AND document_id=NEW.document_id)
      OR (NEW.attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_attempts
        WHERE attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND version_id=NEW.version_id AND document_id=NEW.document_id))
      OR NEW.previous_hash != COALESCE((SELECT evidence_hash FROM document_reconciliations
        WHERE target_key=NEW.target_key ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'')
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Réconciliation existante, orpheline ou périmée'); END

    AFTER INSERT ON document_reconciliations BEGIN INSERT INTO document_events
    (document_id,version_id,kind,reference_id,detail,created_at)

      NEW.detail,NEW.reviewed_at); END

    BEFORE INSERT ON document_attempts WHEN EXISTS(
